issue_context.body:
## Description
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

mem-quota-query can't take effect when reloading config using http api.

1. create config.toml 
mem-quota-query = 100000000
2. start tidb using the config.
3. modify config.toml
mem-quota-query = 100012345
4.  curl -G "127.0.0.1:10080/reload-config"
5. 
[tidb]> show variables like "tidb_mem_quota_query";

review_comments: Does this bug also affect other variables?

In tidb 3.0, only support hot reload some config.
```
var hotReloadConfigItems = []string{"Performance.MaxProcs", "Performance.MaxMemory", "Performance.CrossJoin",
	"Performance.FeedbackProbability", "Performance.QueryFeedbackLimit", "Performance.PseudoEstimateRatio",
	"OOMAction", "MemQuotaQuery", "StmtSummary.MaxStmtCount", "StmtSummary.MaxSQLLength", "TiKVClient.StoreLimit"}
```
In this list, only `MemQuotaQuery` and `TiKVClient.StoreLimit` has defined variable.
`MemQuotaQuery`'s scope is Session, but not init session variable when creating session.
`TiKVClient.StoreLimit`'s scope is Global/Session, so it get global variable and set session variable when creating session.

So that, only MemQuotaQuery will cause the bug.
